title: RestSmp
description: Rest Smp is a cozy community focused Minecraft survival server for players who enjoy peaceful adventure grinding building trading and exploring together with friendly gameplay events economy and a welcoming community
body:
# Rest Smp 🌿

**Rest Smp** is a clean, cozy, and community-focused minecraft survival server made for players who love peaceful survival, grinding, building, trading, exploring, and enjoying a fresh smp experience with friends.

whether you are a casual player who just wants to build a base and chill, or a dedicated survival grinder who loves creating farms, collecting rare items, exploring the world, and becoming one of the richest players on the server — Rest Smp gives you a smooth and enjoyable place to play.

our goal is simple:  
create a survival server that feels **premium, friendly, active, and fun** without making the gameplay too complicated.

---

## ✨ what is Rest Smp?

Rest Smp is a minecraft survival multiplayer server designed around a balanced survival experience. players can explore the world, gather resources, build homes, team up with friends, trade with others, and take part in server activities.

the server is made for players who enjoy classic smp gameplay but also want modern quality-of-life features, a clean community, and a polished server environment.

you can play at your own pace — build peacefully, grind daily, make shops, create towns, join events, or simply relax with the community.

---

## 🌍 server features

- survival-focused gameplay
- friendly and active community
- smooth and optimized server experience
- clean spawn and useful server systems
- economy and trading support
- player progression and grinding
- events and community activities
- fair gameplay rules
- beginner-friendly environment
- perfect for casual and long-term players

---

## 🏡 survival experience

Rest Smp keeps the survival feeling alive while improving the experience with helpful server features. you can start from nothing, collect resources, build your base, upgrade your gear, explore the world, and grow your progress over time.

players can create farms, build villages, trade with others, work together, or go solo. the server is designed to feel relaxing but still rewarding for active players.

---

## ⚔️ community and gameplay

Rest Smp is not just about survival — it is about building a community. players can meet new friends, form teams, trade items, participate in events, and enjoy the server together.

the server is made to be welcoming for new players while still giving experienced minecraft players enough freedom to create big projects, farms, shops, and bases.

---

## 💰 economy and trading

players can trade items, build shops, sell resources, and grow their progress through the server economy. whether you like farming, mining, building, or collecting rare items, there are many ways to play and earn.

the economy is made to support survival gameplay without ruining the natural minecraft experience.

---

## 🎉 events and activities

Rest Smp may include fun events, server activities, and community challenges to keep gameplay fresh. these events are made for players to enjoy, compete, and win rewards while staying connected with the community.

events help make the server more active and give players something exciting to look forward to.

---

## 🛡️ fair and friendly environment

we want Rest Smp to be a safe and fair place for everyone. players are expected to follow the rules, respect others, and keep the server enjoyable.

griefing, cheating, exploiting, and toxic behavior are not welcome. the server is managed to keep gameplay fair and clean for all players.

---

## 🚀 why join Rest Smp?

Rest Smp is perfect if you want a minecraft smp that feels clean, active, peaceful, and fun. it gives you the freedom of survival while adding useful features and a friendly community.

you should join if you like:

- peaceful survival gameplay
- building bases and towns
- grinding and progressing
- trading and economy
- playing with friends
- joining a growing community
- relaxing minecraft gameplay
- long-term smp survival

---

## 📌 server information

**server name:** Rest Smp  
**server ip:** `play.smp.rest`  
**website:** `smp.rest`  
**gamemode:** survival smp  

---

## 🌿 final note

Rest Smp is built for players who want a fresh, clean, and enjoyable minecraft survival experience. join the server, start your journey, build your base, meet new players, and become part of the Rest Smp community.

come relax, grind, build, trade, and survive with us.

**welcome to Rest Smp ✨**
